themes.selection: Follows prefers-color-scheme; a stored choice (localStorage 'jarvis-theme') is applied as data-theme on <html> by a pre-paint script in web/index.html and by web/src/lib/theme.ts.
themes.tokenSuffix: Frontmatter keys ending in -dark are the dark-theme values of the same custom property (e.g. accent-dark redefines --accent).

brand.purpose: The JARVIS wordmark in the lockup only; uppercase, wide tracking.

headline.purpose: Page titles and the auth heading; one per screen.

figure.purpose: KPI values and the money input; tabular numerals. Plan prices step to 1.875rem / -0.03em.

body.purpose: Base text, table cells, row content (rows at weight 500).

body-sm.purpose: Buttons, nav, field labels, segmented options, secondary copy.

label.purpose: Badges, meta lines, table headers, hints, sidebar section names; sentence case.

mono.purpose: Code blocks, endpoint paths, API key prefixes; the pairing token at 1.0625rem / 600 / 0.18em.

shadows.name: shadow-sm
shadows.purpose: Control lift on ghost buttons and the selected segmented option.

shadows.name: shadow-pop
shadows.purpose: Floating layers only: modals and the chart tooltip.

shadows.name: focus-halo
shadows.purpose: Field focus, paired with an accent border.

shadows.name: focus-outline
shadows.purpose: Global :focus-visible ring for everything that is not a field.

motion.name: ease-out
motion.purpose: Movement: modal entrance, switch knob, goal bar fill, theme crossfade.

motion.name: dur
motion.purpose: Default colour, border and opacity transitions.

motion.name: row-actions-reveal
motion.purpose: Transaction row actions float over the right edge and fade in on hover or focus; reminder row actions fade in place.

motion.name: modal-in
motion.purpose: The only animated entrance in the product; backdrop fades in alongside.

motion.name: theme-crossfade
motion.purpose: Whole-page crossfade on theme change; skipped under reduced motion.

motion.name: connect-pulse
motion.purpose: Amber halo on the dot while waiting for WhatsApp pairing.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.value: animations and transitions collapse to 0.01ms; the spinner keeps turning at 1.2s

breakpoints.name: wide
breakpoints.purpose: Column grids collapse to one (three-column to two); KPIs to two across.

breakpoints.name: shell
breakpoints.purpose: Sidebar becomes an icon-only sticky top bar; canvas loses inset, border and radius; even and three-column grids stack.

breakpoints.name: docs
breakpoints.purpose: API docs table of contents stops being a sticky column.

breakpoints.name: compact
breakpoints.purpose: Four-up KPIs hold as 2x2 (8px gap, 12px padding, smaller figures); three-up KPIs stack; transaction and reminder rows move actions under the text.

breakpoints.name: narrow
breakpoints.purpose: Top nav scrolls horizontally without a scrollbar.

narrative.overview:
Jarvis's web panel is a working instrument, not a showcase. The client lives in WhatsApp; they come here to read back what the assistant wrote down and to fix it. So the panel is Linear-grade quiet: dense rows, 1px hairlines, one restrained accent, and type that does all the hierarchy work in a single family. Nothing glows, nothing is in costume. The retro-80s identity the brand started with (Orbitron caps, sunset stripes, orange glow) left the app; only the Michroma wordmark carries the brand's mechanical voice, and it appears once, in the lockup.

The system is one structure in two materials. Light is cream and navy: a warm cream ground, an even paler canvas, near-white cards, navy ink and a deep navy accent. Dark is black and periwinkle: a true-black ground, stepped charcoal surfaces, white-alpha hairlines, near-white ink and a light periwinkle accent derived from the same navy. The theme follows the operating system, can be pinned from the sidebar or the auth screens, and is applied before first paint.

Depth comes from tone, not shadow: the sidebar sits directly on the ground, content lives in an inset rounded canvas one step lighter, and cards are one step lighter again. Status is read the same way everywhere, through a hairline chip led by a small coloured dot, in sentence case.
keyCharacteristics: Two themes from one token set; every colour is a custom property redefined under dark.
Tonal layering: ground, canvas, card, field, each one step apart.
Inter for everything, sentence case, tight negative tracking on headings, tabular numerals on every figure.
1px hairlines everywhere; shadows only on floating layers.
Dot-led status chips as the signature device; dots belong to states only.
Motion is short and functional; the modal is the only animated entrance.

rules.name: The One Accent Rule
rules.body: Each theme has exactly one accent hue, navy or periwinkle. It marks the primary action, focus, selection and links; it is never used as decoration or as a background wash larger than a selected chip or a current plan card (4% mix).

rules.name: The Three-Part State Rule
rules.body: A semantic colour is used as a solid, a soft fill or a line, never at an ad-hoc alpha. Green and red mean money direction and health, amber means waiting; none of them is used for emphasis.

rules.name: The Both-Themes Rule
rules.body: A new colour is a custom property defined in `:root` and redefined in both dark blocks (the `prefers-color-scheme` block and `[data-theme='dark']`). A hex literal in a component is a defect.

rules.name: The Sentence Case Rule
rules.body: No uppercase, no letter-spaced small caps on labels, sections, badges or table headers. The only uppercase in the product is the Michroma wordmark (and the month name's first letter).

rules.name: The Tabular Figures Rule
rules.body: Every number that can change or be compared (amounts, KPIs, counts, dates, times, pagination) uses tabular numerals.

rules.name: The Floating-Only Shadow Rule
rules.body: A shadow means "this sits above the page". Cards, tiles, rows and the canvas never get one; nest depth by tone and hairline instead.

rules.name: The No Nested Card Rule
rules.body: Inside a card, sub-items lose their box: in a list they become rows with a hairline divider, in a grid they become box-less columns (no fill, border or radius, 24px 32px gaps). Never another bordered or tinted card inside a card.

rules.name: The Dot Means State Rule
rules.body: A leading dot is reserved for state. Categories and types take the plain pill; identifiers and versions take the key chip.

rules.name: The One Sub-Nav Rule
rules.body: Every second-level navigation uses the filled pill tabs. No underline tabs, no second tab style.

dos: Do take every colour from a custom property and redefine it in both dark blocks; check both themes before shipping.
Do step depth by tone: ground for the sidebar, `bg` for the canvas, `surface` for cards, `surface-raised` for fields and raised controls.
Do show every status as a dot-led hairline chip in sentence case; let numbers fall into the count variant, types into the plain pill, identifiers and versions into the key chip.
Do use the filled pill tabs for every sub-navigation.
Do keep controls at 34px (28px small) with 6px or 8px radii, cards and tiles at 12px, and borders at 1px.
Do set every changing number in tabular figures, and colour money by direction (green credit, red debit), never by emphasis.
Do keep transitions at 0.15s on colour and border, use `cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1)` for movement, and honour reduced motion.
Do use SVG icons at 13–17px in `ink-faint` or `ink-soft`, labelled when icon-only.
donts: Don't bring back the retro-80s costume: no Orbitron, no sunset stripes, no synthwave grid, no orange glow, no orange anywhere in the app.
Don't put uppercase or letter-spaced labels on sections, badges, table headers or stats; Michroma caps belong to the wordmark alone.
Don't add shadows to cards, tiles, rows or the canvas; shadows are for modals, tooltips and the 1px control lift.
Don't nest a bordered or tinted card inside a card; use hairline rows or box-less columns.
Don't put a dot on anything that is not a state, and don't grey out a disabled primary by opacity.
Don't use a second accent hue, gradients, or semantic colours as decoration.
Don't centre app content in a fixed max-width column; the canvas is fluid.
Don't use emoji or text arrows as interface icons.
